label: Simple Trigonometric Equations
subgoals: Bound solvable sin x = m to |m| <= 1
Cut the unit circle at y = m for alpha and pi - alpha
Append +2k*pi for the full periodic family

label: Trigonometric Equations Solvable by Substitution
subgoals: Substitute t = f(x) to reach sin t = m form
Solve for t first, then unwrap f(x) = t
Collect twin solutions per period of the outer function

label: Example
subgoals: Split cos x = 1/2 into pi/3 and 5pi/3 on [0, 2pi)
Invert tan x = 2 via arctan 2 + k*pi
Fall back to arcsin/arccos for nonstandard values
